title: Sunil Kumar Gupta — pending new-connection application to be decided in law
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: V.K. Shukla, J.; Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; pending connection application to be decided in law.
headnote: Mandamus for a new electric connection. The petitioner could not show that his application had reached the Executive Engineer. Without entering the merits, the Court disposed of the writ hoping that if the application was pending it would be dealt with and decided in accordance with law within the timeframe under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. A later order corrected the shop number from 34-B to 74-B.
facts: Sunil Kumar Gupta sought a mandamus commanding the respondents to issue an electric connection to his shop at 74-B, Vivekpuri (Maya Market), Vishwa Bank Barra, Kanpur Nagar — the shop number later being corrected from 34-B. He produced an application annexed to the writ petition, but nothing on the record showed that it had ever reached the office of the Executive Engineer, Electric Sub Station, Barra. Counsel stated that a copy had been received there, and relied on Seema Mansoor for the mutual obligations of consumer and licensee.

holding_units.holding: Without entering the merits of a mandamus for a new electric connection, if the consumer's application has reached and is pending before the Executive Engineer, it is to be dealt with and decided in accordance with law within the timeframe provided under the Electricity Act, 2003 read with the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: Order invokes EA 2003 and Supply Code 2005 timeframes without naming a section or clause.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner's application had in fact been received in the office of the Executive Engineer
not_decided.note: The record did not show receipt; the Court proceeded only on counsel's statement and a conditional direction.

not_decided.point: Whether an electric connection was to be granted to the shop
not_decided.note: The Court expressly declined to enter the merits.

authorities.name: Seema Mansoor v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
